features.description: Conversational assistant for everything from simple questions to multi-step projects, analysis, and creative writing, on web, desktop, and mobile.
One Claude account works across claude.ai on the web, Claude for iOS, Claude for Android, and Claude Desktop (macOS/Windows; Linux beta).
Editing or retrying prompts mid-conversation is common Claude behavior but is not documented on current help pages (unverified).
Delete or rename any conversation from your chat list.
Claude handles mathematical equations and calculations in chat.
Designs, decks, docs, dashboards, and small interactive apps open beside the conversation; edit, revisit, and share them by link; saved in the Artifacts tab (all plans).
Living documents Claude drafts with clarifying questions and comments; edit yourself and share by link (all plans).
Spreadsheets built into Claude that it creates and edits with you, with import/export and sharing (beta, paid plans).
Shared board where talk, typing, or sketch becomes diagrams and flows; usable during calls (beta, paid plans).
Designs, interactive prototypes, and one-pagers via chat, with on-canvas editing and design systems.
Turns questions about connected data into dashboards, data stories, and narrated videos (paid plans).
Standalone desktop app for scientific research (beta, paid plans).
Self-contained workspaces with their own chat history and knowledge base (free users up to five); new beta version breaks work into parallel cloud threads.
Upload documents to a project so Claude retrieves and cites them during chats.
Built-in web search for factual queries, with sources.
Multi-step research capability for complex, source-heavy questions.
The model menu next to the send button sets which Claude model you use, its effort level, and whether thinking is on; changeable mid-conversation.
Optional deeper reasoning; official guidance explains when to use web search vs extended thinking vs research.
Complete spoken conversations on mobile, desktop, and web (all plans); switch between text and voice; uses web search and connected tools like Gmail, Calendar, Docs, and Slack.
Dictate prompts as text in Claude Mobile.
Upload PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, HTML, ODT, RTF, EPUB, JSON, XLSX, and images (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP) via the + menu or drag-and-drop.
Claude creates and edits files in chat (via the code execution and file creation setting).
Claude analyzes uploaded images but does not generate images.
Claude renders charts, diagrams, and interactive content in chat.
Ask Claude to search past conversations and pull relevant details into new chats (paid plans).
Claude remembers context across chats and into Cowork tasks; review, edit, import, export, or turn off.
Account-wide personalization instructions applied to every conversation.
Temporary chats excluded from history, memory, and model training (all plans).
Snapshot share links for chats, plus newer options to share with specific people or via public links.
Pre-built connectors (Google Workspace, GitHub, Microsoft 365, Slack, 1Password, Personal Finance) plus custom remote-MCP connectors.
Reusable instructions and workflows; browse, use, and create custom skills.
Browse skills, connectors, and plugins in one directory and manage them from one Plugins page.
Agentic workspace bringing Claude Code's capabilities to knowledge work (paid plans) on desktop, web, mobile, and the Chrome side panel.
Assign and manage tasks from anywhere in Claude Cowork; no standalone consumer scheduled-task feature is documented (unverified absence).
Claude side panel in the Chrome browser (all paid plans).
Research preview (US, paid plans): message Claude like a person; it works in your connected apps and asks before sending, paying, or signing anything.
A browser running on Anthropic's servers that you can hand to Claude and take back (beta, Pro/Max/Ultra).
A monthly summary of your Claude usage.
Wellbeing settings for scheduled breaks and quiet hours.
No push-notification feature is documented for Claude apps; break reminders and quiet hours are the only related setting (unverified absence).
Customize Claude's appearance and theme.
Use Claude in your preferred language.
Use Claude inside Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides.
Invoke Claude Desktop from anywhere on Mac via quick entry.
Interop that lets Claude work with your Android apps.
